title: Submission smoke: verify live scorer before any model
description: Write the submission path (LibriBrainCompetitionHoldout -> write_submission, vocab order from pnpl vocabulary.csv incl. curly it's). Submit (a) a uniform/word-frequency prior to read the live scorer's floor. Answers: top-10 vs argmax, word rows scored?, it's spelling. Costs 1-2 of 10/day. Needs holdout only (5.7 GB), not training data.

title: Fetch subj0 preprocessed h5+tsv (~60GB) + holdout npz (5.7GB)
description: HF pnpl/LibriBrain Sherlock1-7 .h5/.tsv only (skip ~484GB raw .fif); pnpl/LibriBrain-Competition-2026. Into <data>/raw/pnpl_libribrain. Needs core paths loader (port from rsna_knee_kaggle core/paths.py) + uv add pnpl.
notes: Audit 2026-10-01: Deep train = sub-0 Sherlock1-9 + TIMIT + MOCHA + Podcasts (pnpl manifest), not Sherlock1-7. Re-measure .h5+.tsv size via HF tree API before fetching. Use pnpl's download (fetches .h5+.tsv only) into DataRoot.raw(). Holdout: LibriBrainCompetitionHoldout(data_path=...).

title: Deep track: replicate d'Ascoli ref (73.23% BAcc@10) then build past
description: Ported from mindscape-qbv8. subj0 ~80h MEG 306ch, 50-word vocab. Step 1 reproduce ref on official splits via pnpl LibriBrainWord; step 2 levers: contrastive alignment to speech embeddings, MEG-XL fine-tune, context window. See docs/PLAN.md.

title: Sentence-context lever on the sentence holdout
description: subjXX_holdout01_sentence.npz gives (156,306,1030) MEG + word_onsets_s/word_mask (<=9 words). Per-word decode + cross-word context (neighbour MEG, language prior over 50-word vocab). Blocked on Deep replication; size gain only once scoring split of word vs sentence holdout is known.

title: Broad track: Deep backbone + subject alignment, 40/20/10 min calibration
description: Ported from mindscape-dgq2. 32 subjects ~40min, ref MEG-XL 42.96% BAcc@10, subj0 allowed. Levers: Euclidean/Riemannian alignment, subject layer, minutes-vs-accuracy curve.
